topic: How do interference mitigation techniques adapt when handling tunneled versus non-tunneled traffic in multi-beam satellite systems?
consensus_response: Interference mitigation techniques adapt by employing dynamic beam allocation and hybrid beamforming for tunneled traffic, reducing encapsulation overhead. For non-tunneled traffic, adaptive modulation and spectrum management are utilized, leveraging AI for predictive modeling to optimize resource allocation and minimize co-channel interference.
reference_context: Multi-beam satellite systems face interference challenges, necessitating techniques like rate-splitting multiple access and beamforming to manage inter-beam interference.
